correctness.rationale: Strict convexity of |t|^p and connectedness yield a unique minimizer; cube coordinate permutation invariance makes it radial by Hamming layer. There are d*binom(d-1,k) edges between consecutive layers; Hölder gives unique increments proportional to binom(d-1,k)^(-1/(p-1)), establishing linearity for two boundary values despite nonlinear energy. Graph Lipschitz seminorm is max absolute edge increment, while boundary Lipschitz norm is |Δf|/d, giving exact d/S. Interior binomials >1 prove finite-d monotonicity; only two endpoint terms survive for fixed p as d grows. Uniform binomial entropy estimates and Riemann sums prove the p/d finite-ratio integral; central strip bounds yield divergence for ratio0, uniform bounded entropy gives limit1 at infinity. Independently tested nonlinear radial Euler equations and edge slopes for d<=8 and multiple p. Those checks are corroboration; the universal proof is analytic.
residual_risks: Two antipodes, real scalars, unit Hamming graph metric and energy-selected extension only; d=2 has norm one.
